content: Assignment of SOMEIPTransformationProps to a root Au- tosarDataPrototype in a SenderReceiverInterface typed by an Appli- cationDataType To assign the SOMEIPTransformationProps to a root Au- tosarDataPrototype in a SenderReceiverInterface that is typed by an ApplicationDataType the DataPrototypeInSenderReceiverInterfaceIn- stanceRef shall reference the DataPrototype with the targetDataPrototype- InSr reference. The rootDataPrototypeInSr and contextDataPrototype- InSr references shall not be used.
